purpose: Behavior cases for sparse priority, status, relationship, and archive-candidate title semantics.

cases.input: Three current tasks are unfinished: database reconciliation risks losing recoverable history, an implementation has a routine next feature, and a migration awaits a non-urgent choice. The full accessible scope was reviewed.
One task names an exact next implementation step; another merely says improvements may be possible someday.
A migration awaits owner approval. A recovery task cannot continue because its database is locked and needs remediation.
A verified architecture decision is still authoritative. A separate verified one-off availability check has no remaining work or durable reference value.
An older plan was explicitly replaced by named task T2. A different old plan only resembles recent work with no successor evidence.
A thirty-day-old task remains the only source for an unfinished migration.
Crest research pruning is complete and directly verified; project and cleanup symbols are useful and no cross-task marker applies.
